'''Drawing Bridges''' (Japanese: '''VS ガマガル''' ''VS Palpitoad''), titled '''VS Palpitoad''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 489th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 29th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}.

It is subtitled '''Palpitoad''' (Japanese: '''跳橋''' ''Drawbridge'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Drawing Bridges''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation.

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* A {{TP|N|Zorua}} causes havoc on the [[Driftveil Drawbridge]], making people unable to cross it.
* With help from [[Elesa]], {{adv|Black}} gets past the drawbridge.
* Black faces the trouble-making Zorua on the drawbridge.
* Black defeats the Zorua, causing it to flee.
* Black meets [[Clay]], the {{ci|Driftveil}} [[Gym Leader]].
